Los Angeles Leverset with Square Roses

text.description_html:
AHI LOS-ANGELES, Explore Hardware Los Angeles Lever

The Satin Nickel Modern Los Angeles Lever with Square Rose is all you need to update your doors. These modern leversets add sleek style and are easy to install. The Explore Hardware Los Angeles Lever is available in dummy, passage, and privacy functions. It will fit most 2-1/8 inch standard bore holes. The satin nickel finish is a contemporary classic.

Features of the Satin Nickel Los Angeles Lever:

  • Fits standard door cut outs (2-1/8" pre-drilled doors).
  • Solid metal lever and trim rose.
  • Sold as complete set.
  • Easy to install.

Specifications of the Los Angeles Leverset with Square Rose:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Lever Length: 4.98" (126.4mm)
  • Lever Width: 0.55" (13.9mm)
  • Lever Projection: 2.06" (52.4mm)
  • Rose Length: 2.36" (59.9mm) square
  • Rose Projection: 0.39" (10mm)
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Handing: non-handed
  • AHI Los Angeles Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Available Functions:

  • Single Dummy: No door latch. Door lever on one side of the door. Visible surface mounting screws. Package Includes: 1 lever, 1 rose, and mounting screws.
  • Double Dummy: No door latch. Door levers on both sides of the door. Visible surface mounting screws on interior and exterior. Package Includes: 2 levers, 2 roses, and mounting screws.
  • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door. Visible mounting screws on interior. Package Includes: 2 levers, 2 roses, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): For doors that could need privacy locking. Latch operates from either side. Privacy pin on interior rose engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Visible mounting screws on interior. Package Includes: 2 levers, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.

Sold Individually
